items.title: Delfeayo Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was still at Berklee when I played with Fats.

ctx.x: In ’88. I was still at Berklee when I played with Fats. It was great. He generally didn’t use trombone. Again, learned a lot from him and Ray about playing the same material, but as though it’s the first time.
Then the next person they mention is Abdullah Ibrahim, working in his group.
